fruits.name: Common Goblin Fruit
fruits.description: A million fancies; most Hedge fruit restores Glamour.

fruits.name: Amaranthine
fruits.description: Soft red eggplant of compassion; smells of hope and cinnamon.

fruits.name: Faerie Peach
fruits.description: Plump, fragile peach that feeds on True Fae radiance.
fruits.effect: Treat Thorns as Hedge and Hedge as trod until leave or a day/night. Nearby fae sense you. +1 Glamour.

fruits.name: Liar's Apple
fruits.description: Delicious red apple from deceptively pleasant groves.
fruits.effect: Cannot tell the truth until sunrise after next. +1 Glamour.

effects.text: Cannot tell the truth until sunrise after next.

fruits.name: Odinroot
fruits.description: Grows from bare rock where Thorn-blood fell.
fruits.effect: +1 Glamour, +1 Willpower; Clarity attack (1 die) — staff resolve.

effects.text: Clarity attack (1-die pool) — resolve with +integrity/break or ST.

fruits.name: Ogre Pepper
fruits.description: Jagged chili of wrath and guilt; mouth bleeds but no damage.
fruits.effect: Fearless until next midnight when pursuing a true goal; −2 self-control. +1 Glamour.

effects.text: Auto-succeed fear contest; −2 self-control until midnight.

fruits.name: Vines of Bacchus
fruits.description: Plump cheerful vines; foul to those who wish harm nearby.
fruits.effect: Restore 1 Glamour. Useful for sniffing out hostile intent (RP).

effects.text: Tastes foul to those who wish harm on people nearby.

fruits.name: Jennystone
fruits.effect: Swallow for 1 Glamour (Stamina roll in full rules). Smell: −1 non-reflexive nearby.

fruits.name: Cogleaf
fruits.description: Metallic cog-leaf; universal small replacement part.
fruits.effect: Repair a small hidden broken part (RP). Not eaten for Glamour.

effects.text: Install to repair a small hidden broken part (scene RP).

fruits.name: Lancebeet
fruits.description: Long thin beet that tapers to a point; throwable once.
fruits.effect: Eat: 1 Glamour (apple-sweet). Or throw as weapon +3 (then gone).

effects.text: Alt: throw as weapon (+3 dice) then withers.
